risk_if_not_implemented: Without Telecommunications Services Availability, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Space Weather (NT-9); Utility Service Disruption (MT-7), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Infrastructure Failure / Degradation (MT-27).

compensating_control_1.name: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Domain Name Service (DNS) resolution is designed, implemented and managed to protect the security of name / address resolution.
compensating_control_1.justification: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution (NET-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Telecommunications Services Availability (BCD-17) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Alternate Processing Site
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides processing capability and security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.
compensating_control_2.justification: Alternate Processing Site (BCD-13) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Telecommunications Services Availability (BCD-17) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
